soh_build.scope: Official standalone Torch at Shipwright 9.3.1's pinned commit. Source files are not patched. CMake uses the same officially defined OoT format options, while USE_STANDALONE enables Torch's own CLI. Build dependencies are exported at their official pinned commits from existing local git caches. No ROM or game execution.
